description: Master contact database consolidating Leads (11,466), Clients (27), and Warm Network (8,291) with deduplication and workflow tracking

master_table.purpose: Single source of truth for all prospect and customer relationships

columns.name: contact_id
columns.description: Unique internal ID (auto-generated UUID or incremental with date prefix). Primary key.

columns.name: dedup_hash
columns.description: SHA256 hash of (mobile + email + name_surname). Used to identify duplicates across import sources. Computed field.

columns.name: source_ids
columns.description: Original IDs from source systems (Leads, Clients, Warm Network). Tracks merge history.

columns.name: contact_type
columns.description: Primary categorization. Updated as contact progresses through funnel.

columns.name: contact_subtype
columns.description: Hierarchical subtype for reporting (e.g., Lead:HNI, Client:Dormant).

columns.name: tier
columns.description: Priority tier for outreach: A=High value, B=Medium, C=Low. Applies to Leads & Warm Network.

columns.name: segment
columns.description: Customer segment for tailored strategy.

columns.name: priority
columns.description: Warm Network priority override (supersedes tier if set).

columns.name: name
columns.description: Full name. Trimmed, title-cased.

columns.name: mobile
columns.description: Primary 10-digit Indian mobile (6-9 prefix). Index for dedup & SMS.

columns.name: mobile_2
columns.description: Secondary mobile number.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Email address. Index for dedup & outreach.

columns.name: city
columns.description: City of residence or business. Populated from Clients; optional for Leads & Warm.

columns.name: employer
columns.description: Employer or company name (Salaried/Business segments).

columns.name: job_title
columns.description: Job title or designation.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current funnel status. Transitions governed by contact_type (see status_transitions).

columns.name: status_updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp of last status change. Auto-updated.

columns.name: owner
columns.description: Assigned relationship manager.

columns.name: whose
columns.description: Warm Network source (whose connection). NULL for Leads & Clients.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Temperature of lead (relationship depth).

columns.name: list
columns.description: Source list or campaign (for Leads). NULL for Clients.

columns.name: approach_strategy
columns.example: Referral via Hitesh; mention mutual connection
columns.description: Warm Network contact strategy. Guides first outreach message.

columns.name: already_in_db
columns.description: Warm Network flag: already in LEADS or CLIENTS? Guides merge logic.

columns.name: budget
columns.description: Lead investment budget or capacity (in Rupees). For qualification.

columns.name: aum
columns.description: Assets Under Management (Clients only). Basis for commission estimates.

columns.name: monthly_commit
columns.description: Monthly SIP or commit amount (Clients only).

columns.name: lifetime_commission
columns.description: Total commission earned from this contact (Clients only). Computed.

columns.name: products
columns.description: Products this contact holds or is interested in (Clients) or invested in (Leads).

columns.name: policy_numbers
columns.description: Insurance policy or investment identifiers (Clients only).

columns.name: next_action
columns.example: Call on Wednesday 2-3pm; discuss MF portfolio
columns.description: Planned next step (Leads & Warm Network).

columns.name: next_action_date
columns.description: Scheduled date for next_action. Drives task list.

columns.name: last_contact
columns.description: Timestamp of last phone call, email, SMS, or meeting.

columns.name: last_contact_type
columns.description: Channel of last contact.

columns.name: next_review
columns.description: Scheduled review or renewal date (Clients only).

columns.name: date_added
columns.description: Record creation date in this system. Auto-set on insert.

columns.name: date_converted
columns.description: Date lead converted to client (status = Converted). Auto-set.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Freeform notes on relationship, preferences, history.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Last modification timestamp. Auto-updated on any change.

deduplication_logic.step1_hash_creation: Compute dedup_hash = SHA256(LOWER(TRIM(mobile)) + '|' + LOWER(TRIM(email)) + '|' + LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT(name)[0])) + '|' + LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT(name)[-1])))
deduplication_logic.step2_exact_match: Query CONTACTS WHERE dedup_hash = incoming_hash. If found, merge (see merge_strategy).
deduplication_logic.step3_fuzzy_match: If no exact match and source=Lead/WarmNetwork: fuzzy match on (name + mobile) with 85%+ similarity. Flag for manual review if match found.
deduplication_logic.step4_insert_or_merge: If no matches: INSERT new record. If match found: MERGE into existing record (retain contact_id, append source_ids, reconcile fields per source_priority).

merge_strategy.keep: contact_id (existing), date_added (earlier of two), created_at, dedup_hash
merge_strategy.merge_notes_example: [2026-08-12 MERGE: LEAD-5142 + WARM-1847] LEAD tier=A, segment=HNI merged with WARM owner=Hitesh, approach='referral via Hitesh'. Contact was already known.

LEAD_workflow.rules: Once Converted, status is terminal (cannot revert). DNCall (Do Not Call) is quasi-terminal but reopenable if contact re-engages.

CLIENT_workflow.rules: Inactive is terminal (client opted out). Dormant = no contact in 6+ months but relationship intact.

WARM_NETWORK_workflow.rules: Warm Network is often ephemeral; conversion = becomes CLIENT. Not_Interested contacts can be re-engaged if new intelligence surfaces.

data_validation_rules.email: Valid email format OR NULL (not empty string)
data_validation_rules.budget: If segment=HNI or Business, strongly recommended; nullable
data_validation_rules.status: Must be in allowed_values for contact_type; transitions must be valid
data_validation_rules.segment: Based on job_title, employer, budget signals
data_validation_rules.name: Non-empty, trimmed, max 100 chars
data_validation_rules.date_converted: Must be >= date_added, set only when status=Converted
data_validation_rules.next_action_date: If set, must be future date or today
data_validation_rules.dedup_hash: Immutable after creation; recompute only on name/mobile/email change

reporting_dimensions.by_contact_type: LEAD vs CLIENT vs WARM_NETWORK (funnel split)
reporting_dimensions.by_status: Uncontacted vs Contacted vs Interested vs Converted (funnel depth)
reporting_dimensions.funnel_velocity: Days from Contacted → Interested → Meeting → Converted (by owner, segment)
reporting_dimensions.aum_by_segment: Total AUM by customer segment (revenue potential)
reporting_dimensions.commission_yield: Commission per contact type, per product (profitability)

migration_notes.from_leads_table: Import all 11,466 rows. Compute dedup_hash on each. Default contact_type='LEAD', owner='Unassigned', source='Cold/Warm/Hot' (from source column). Map status values: Uncontacted/Contacted/Interested/Meeting/DNCall → Unified enum.
migration_notes.from_clients_table: Import all 27 rows. Set contact_type='CLIENT', status='Active' (default), owner='Unassigned'. Prioritize name, email, mobile from CLIENT table on merge.
migration_notes.from_warm_network_table: Import all 8,291 rows. Set contact_type='WARM_NETWORK', whose=(Own/Hitesh/Manohar), priority=(A/B/C). Check already_in_db before import; if Y, flag for merge review.
migration_notes.dedup_on_import: Post-import, identify duplicates via dedup_hash. Flag top 100 highest-value dupes (by budget/aum) for manual review before merge.
migration_notes.source_ids_tracking: Preserve original IDs (LEAD-*, CLIENT-*, WARM-*) in source_ids array for audit trail and future reverse-mapping if needed.
